function.arguments: {"finding": "The treatment arm is not randomized; clinicians preferentially assigned treatment to sicker patients. In the deduplicated data, the treatment arm has a higher proportion of severe patients (109/290 ≈ 37.6%) compared to the control arm (21/510 ≈ 4.1%), and also a higher proportion of moderate cases. Meanwhile, mild cases are underrepresented in the treatment arm. Since severity is a strong predictor of response (sicker patients are less likely to respond), the comparison of response rates between males and females in the treatment arm is confounded by severity. Without adjusting for severity, any observed difference in response rates between genders could be due to the imbalance in baseline severity rather than gender itself.", "action": "We adjusted for severity using direct standardization to the overall severity distribution in the treatment arm. This gives a valid estimate of the gender difference in response rates, independent of the confounding by severity."}
function.name: resolve_finding
